about_the_game:
Reduce thousands of zombie foods to mush!

The Last Kich of Us is a survivors-like / bullet heaven / auto-shooter type action rogue-lite that immerses you in a quirky post-apocalyptic universe, enhanced by its hand-drawn characters.

Gain power to pulverize hordes of rotten food. Play as iconic characters, referencing various pop culture universes, with their own unique skills, and complete the ultimate battle of Kichman, the last slice of quiche that can unite all powers!

It's time to prove that even if you happen to be a quiche (French expression to say that you are hopeless), your fate is not sealed!

Play as iconic characters!

From a young wizard to a space knight, including superheroes, each character has powers specific to each universe!

Risk your life in the putrid fog!

Beware of the fog that invades the area. Depending on its color, it applies a different negative effect. You'll have to choose the right moment to risk venturing into it to collect resources, flee from enemies, or even more crucially, to recover XP or an energy orb, your only way to improve your character in the middle of combat!

Make the right decisions to survive!

Your survival will depend on difficult choices, including whether or not to wait before activating an energy orb. The longer you wait, the greater your chances of obtaining a rare upgrade. But in the face of an ever-increasing threat, every second of waiting could be your last...

Experiment unusual combinations that could prove devastating!

Kichman will be able to use the skills of the game's various characters once unlocked. This gives you the opportunity to create power combinations that blend different pop culture universes. Each unlocked skill opens the door to new builds!

Development Team

This game is the result of a collaboration between:

- Avnuts, in charge of game development and 3D visual effects.

- Iti63, the 2D artist behind Kichman and this offbeat universe.

We truly hope you enjoy this passionately crafted game as much as we do.

name: The Last Kich Of Us
short_description: You are the LAST slice of quiche! Dive into this survivors-like to pulverize hordes of rotten food with pop culture-inspired attacks, while avoiding the putrid fog. Choose wisely: grab upgrades now, or wait for better odds—every second could be your last.
